name: basketball-assistant
description: 1,000+ coach-reviewed drills and plays, practice plans for your team's age and level, and your roster, schedule and attendance, right in the chat.

interface.longDescription:
Basketball Assistant is a coaching assistant for volunteer basketball coaches — the parents, teachers and club volunteers who run youth practices every week.

Ask in plain English and walk into practice with a plan:

- A practice plan in seconds — tell it the focus, how long you have, and your team's age and level; it builds a timed session from warm-up to cool-down out of library drills, ready to edit, save and share
- 1,000+ coach-reviewed drills and plays, each one complete: step-by-step instructions, coaching points, common errors to watch for, and variations
- Plays with court diagrams, play series that teach a whole offense, and drill combos that build one skill step by step
- Your team in one place: roster, season calendar and attendance — players and parents can say yes or no to each practice
- Training plans for individual players, a court diagram creator, and on-court competitions and tournaments with a scoring page for the phone at the court

Answers you can coach from — why a drill works, what to say when it breaks down, how to make it easier for your youngest players.

Connect once with your Basketball Assistant account — a new coach creates it in the same step.

Built for the love of basketball.
defaultPrompt: Find fun warm-up drills for a beginner team in Basketball Assistant
Show me how to run the drill "Dribble Tag" in Basketball Assistant
Draft a 60-minute ball-handling practice for 10 beginners (U12) in Basketball Assistant

positive.description: Open full instructions for a named library drill. If ChatGPT asks you to connect, sign in with the test credentials. Works in a fresh chat; no other case needed.
positive.prompt: Show the full instructions for the drill "Dribble Tag" in Basketball Assistant
positive.expected_behavior: Step-by-step instructions for the named drill from the app's library — setup, coaching points, common errors and variations — as an interactive drill card or structured text. Same drill, same content on every run; nothing is invented. A search_all lookup first is also correct.

positive.description: Open a named play from the library (court diagram, execution, coaching points). If ChatGPT asks you to connect, sign in with the test credentials. Works in a fresh chat.
positive.prompt: Show the play "5-Out Pass and Cut" in Basketball Assistant
positive.expected_behavior: The named play from the app's library — description, court diagram, coaching points, common errors and when to use it — as an interactive play viewer or structured text. Same play, same content on every run; nothing is invented. A search_all lookup first is also correct.

positive.description: See the demo coach's team. If ChatGPT asks you to connect, sign in with the test credentials. Works in a fresh chat; reads only.
positive.prompt: Show my teams in Basketball Assistant
positive.expected_behavior: The demo coach's team, Lakeside Falcons (U12), with ways into its roster, schedule, practice plans and invites — as an interactive team hub or a text summary. Same team on every run; nothing is created or changed.

positive.description: See the demo team's upcoming practices. If ChatGPT asks you to connect, sign in with the test credentials. Works in a fresh chat; reads only.
positive.prompt: Show the schedule for my team Lakeside Falcons in Basketball Assistant
positive.expected_behavior: Lakeside Falcons' upcoming practices for the next 30 days — each with its date, time and any linked practice plan — as an interactive season calendar or a text list. The calendar only reads; nothing is scheduled or changed. A get_my_teams lookup first is also correct.

positive.description: Open one of the demo coach's saved practice plans by name. If ChatGPT asks you to connect, sign in with the test credentials. Works in a fresh chat; reads only.
positive.prompt: Open the practice plan "Shooting Form Builder" in Basketball Assistant
positive.expected_behavior: The saved plan "Shooting Form Builder" — its timed segments in order, with their drills and durations — as an interactive plan viewer or structured text. Same plan on every run; nothing is edited. A search_practice_plans lookup first is also correct.

negative.description: Professional basketball news and results — the app is a coaching assistant for youth teams, not a sports news or stats service.
negative.prompt: Who won the NBA finals last season, and who was MVP?

negative.description: Watching or streaming games — the app has no broadcast or streaming information.
negative.prompt: Where can I watch tonight's Lakers game?

negative.description: Shopping for equipment — the app teaches drills and manages teams; it does not sell or recommend gear.
negative.prompt: What basketball shoes should I buy for indoor courts?

publication.release_notes:
Version 1.8: from tonight's practice to a team that runs itself, one step at a time.

- Describe your players, how long you have and your court, and get a timed practice on the first try, with no setup first
- It tells you what it assumed, like half a court or beginner-friendly drills, so you can change it
- Only have half a court? Drills that need the whole floor are left out
- Like the plan? Say "Remember this as my team" and your age group, gym, equipment and practice days are saved in one step
- After each step, it suggests the next one: save the plan, add your practice days, invite your assistant coach
- Turn a drill, or the drills you just found, into a full practice with one tap
- If you want it, an email the evening before a practice that has no plan yet
- It knows how to teach each part of the game at your players' age, from shooting and passing to team defense, so plans and answers are positive and fit the kids in front of you
- Draw a play on the spots your team uses: 5-out, or 4-out 1-in with two slots and two deep wings. The picture shows every open lane to the basket, and the room after a handoff
